errors.text_span: 增加到captured_distance为2时的约76.5%，然后在captured_distance为5时达到峰值约77%
errors.evidence: The description of the Acc value's trend is over-simplified. It omits the fact that the value slightly decreases or plateaus between captured_distance=2 and captured_distance=4 before rising to its peak at 5.
The F1 value at captured_distance=2 is approximately 77.7%, not 77.5%.
The F1 value at captured_distance=5 is the peak, but it is clearly below the 78% line, at approximately 77.9%.
The Acc value at captured_distance=1 is approximately 75.8%, which is visibly below 76%.
The Acc value at its peak (captured_distance=5) is approximately 77.2%, which is visibly above the 77% mark.
